diaphragmatic myofibre injury (myottrauma) is a mechanism by which mechanical ventilation can cause prolonged mechanical ventilation and worse clinical outcomes in patients with acute respiratory failure.

diaphragm muscle function is a potential mediator of prolonged mechanical ventilation and poor patient survival in acute respiratory failure.
